seed.content: Side project: a small Python script that needs somewhere to run

rounds.user: is there any free VPS I could run this on? how would I even set one up
rounds.assistant: Yes — AWS Free Tier gives you a small EC2 instance for 12 months. The steps would be: 1. Create an AWS account at aws.amazon.com. 2. Open the EC2 Free Tier page and pick a t2.micro. 3. Launch the instance with Ubuntu. 4. Create a key pair and download the .pem file to SSH in. Oracle Cloud also has an always-free tier if you prefer.

rounds.assistant: The double count comes from reading the last line twice — once in the loop and once after it. Drop the trailing read and the total is right.
